# single authority on whether the upstream chain is at a consumable posture,
# instead of restating a status comparison. The flag is what scopes the check
# to the one chain, so it is named.
# Phase 6 runs the wip-hygiene scan with `git grep`, removes a rejected draft
# with `git rm`, and commits the rationale with `git commit -F`.
# Working state is koto context keys in the `design-<topic>` session: `koto context add`,
# `get`, `exists` and `remove` on single keys, and `koto context list --prefix` over
# a key directory. The session is opened and closed through scripts/skill-session.sh,
# whose own koto floor is declared where that script lives.
